headline: Sensex Drops 500 Points as US Fed Rate Hike Concerns and Inflation Fears Trigger Market Sell-off

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: US Fed minutes revived interest rate hike fears after policymakers focused on inflation risks.
Profit booking took place following a brief two-day rally in Indian equities.
Declines in global markets and mixed Asian trading exerted downward pressure.
Losses in metals, consumer durables, and IT stocks dragged down benchmark indices.
whatHappening: Sensex dropped over 500 points while Nifty settled at 25,228.
Nifty IT Index fell by 1.2% during market trading.
Titan stock plunged over 4%, pulling down the consumer durables space.
Brent crude oil slipped below $92 amid deepening supply glut concerns.
summary:
Indian stock markets snapped a two-day rally as the Sensex dropped over 500 points and Nifty slipped to 25,228.
Global rate-hike concerns from the US Fed and persistent inflation risks weighed on market sentiment.
Metals, IT, and consumer durable stocks led the decline, with Titan sinking over 4%.
